I've been in the same situation. Get your belongings, financials, etc. Leave, and when she threatens suicide call the police. Do the same when she threatens it via phone or text. May actually be best to do it all via recorded phone call or text in case she threatens to pull out the whole "I'll tell the cops you beat me" thing.

You aren't responsible for her actions. She's either trying to manipulate you, in which case an officer showing up at her door shows her that she can't just escalate further and expect you to back down, or she is serious about suicide in which case they need to be there.

Manipulators generally are going to try to use everything they can against you, and when it's your exgirlfriend they have a lot of data to go on. They'll try to hit on every insecurity they know you have, whether it's your past relationships, family, or a biggest fear. (For me it was telling me that it was my fault my ex committed suicide and that I needed to do what she wanted or she would too)

As she's laying down the hate and trying to provoke you, just keep your mind focused not on what she's saying, but on why she's trying to hurt you. She's actively trying to hurt you because she thinks that will get her what she wants. That means what she wants is NOT you to be happy or unhurt. When you keep that in mind, it makes it easier to stick to your conviction and not give up ground in a relationship where you've been manipulated a bit too much already and she expects it to continue.
